steps: Draft personal narrative about the SEVIS termination and reinstatement process -- detailed explanation of the violation, timeline of events, commitment to compliance
Explain the reason for the original COS (if there was one)
Gather proof of ties to home country (family, residence, employment, academic history)
Confirm academic history is consistent with the study plan

Link for document upload folders sent
Google Drive folder created per item (organization + payments and translations)

phases.name: Finalization
steps: Client instructed to maintain full-time study

pricing.notes: Baseline = School (ESL/language school) variant. Same contract also prices a University variant higher: Standard $580, Plus Online $1,195, Plus Paper $1,320 — quote the University price for a college/university reinstatement case.
